changes.checkingConflictMarkers: Still checking files for conflict markers
changes.discardAllDescription: All uncommitted changes are discarded: tracked files reset to the last commit, untracked files move to the recycle bin.{{reservedNote}}
changes.discardStagedDescription: Unstaged changes to {{path}} will be discarded, returning it to its staged version. Its staged changes are kept. This cannot be undone.
changes.discardTrackedDescription: Unstaged changes to {{path}} will be restored to the last committed version. This cannot be undone.
changes.discardReservedDescription: {{path}} is untracked. Its Windows-reserved name can't go to the recycle bin, so it will be deleted permanently.
changes.discardUntrackedDescription: {{path}} is untracked — it will be moved to the recycle bin.
changes.discardManyDescription: Changes to {{count}} files will be discarded — tracked files are restored and untracked files moved to the recycle bin. This cannot be undone.{{reservedNote}}
changes.reservedDiscardNote: Files with Windows-reserved names (like "nul") skip the recycle bin and are deleted permanently.
changes.stashAllDescription: Sets your working tree back to the last commit and saves all uncommitted changes — including untracked files — to the stash. "Pop latest stash" restores them.
changes.stashOneDescription: {{path}} is saved to the stash and removed from your working tree. "Pop latest stash" restores it.
changes.stashManyDescription: {{count}} selected files are saved to the stash and removed from your working tree. "Pop latest stash" restores them.
changes.reservedOnlyReason: Git can't stage Windows-reserved device names, and every file here has one
changes.flatList: Show changes as a flat list
changes.viewStashes: View stashed changes on this branch

conflicts.stashListChanged: The stash list changed — nothing was dropped.
conflicts.backupStashGone: The backup stash is already gone, so there was nothing to drop.
conflicts.commitSkipped: Commit skipped — your resolution left nothing to commit.
conflicts.rebaseEditPaused: Rebase paused — amend this commit's changes in Changes, then Continue
conflicts.resolveInChanges_one: {{conflict}} — resolve it in the changes list.
conflicts.resolveInChanges_other: {{conflict}} — resolve them in the changes list.
conflicts.abortEditingHistoryDescription: Abandons the rebase and restores your branch to its original history. Any changes you've amended into this commit are lost.
conflicts.dropBackupAfterSha: saved before the {{operation}}, along with the changes it holds. Your working tree stays as it is now. This cannot be undone.
conflicts.differentStashDropped: The stash list changed — a different stash ({{sha}}) was dropped and couldn't be restored. Recover it under View stashes → Recoverable.

stashReapply.conflictedTail_one: The {{operation}} finished. Resolve it in the changes list; your changes are also kept in a backup stash.
stashReapply.conflictedTail_other: The {{operation}} finished. Resolve them in the changes list; your changes are also kept in a backup stash.
stashReapply.resolvedLead: Reapplying your stashed changes · all conflicts resolved
stashReapply.resolvedTail: Drop the backup stash if your changes look right, or keep it in View stashes.
stashReapply.resolvedAnnouncement: All conflicts resolved. Drop the backup stash if your changes look right, or keep it in View stashes.

merge.abortDescription: Abandons the in-progress merge and restores the repository to the state before it started. Any conflict resolutions you've made will be lost.

rebase.abortDescription: Abandons the in-progress rebase and restores the repository to the state before it started. Any conflict resolutions you've made will be lost.

cherry-pick.abortDescription: Abandons the in-progress cherry-pick and restores this branch to the state before the pick started. You stay on this branch, and any conflict resolutions you've made will be lost.

revert.abortDescription: Abandons the in-progress revert and restores the repository to the state before it started. Any conflict resolutions you've made will be lost.
